claims: Costco warehouses are closed on Easter Sunday.
Costco warehouses are closed on Sunday, April 5, 2026.
Costco stores will resume normal business hours on Monday, April 6.
Easter is one of the seven major U.S. holidays when Costco warehouses are closed.
While Costco warehouses are closed, Costco's website is still open.
While Costco warehouses are closed, no deliveries will be processed until the following day.
